interpretation: A nested process controller which uses start_new_session can leave a live worker after the v2.2 outer process group is killed. The candidate v3 code spawns detached bootstrap and workers in independent sessions; do not nest its controller under v2.2 watchdog until process ownership is independently proven.
next_action: Use v2.2 as the sole owner/dispatcher; extract v3 stateless receipt/spec validators and bound logging only, then test Linux and Windows under exact current-main authority. No dual-controller merge.
